rationale: Both use D*g contributions and cosine-to-sign-pattern latent tagging. A flips all style properties together and calls none when the shift's sign is wrong, picking cues from a gradient-category table. B uses single-factor minimal pairs and divides by a topic-toggle shift, plus an all-property ablation bound. Latent gating differs (concentration vs norm), as do inspection-based drops and cue count.
